ai.s: Adds a V3 endpoint listing an event's exhibitors with pagination and incremental fetching by timestamp.
ai.pr: Exhibitor lists relied on V2 /api/v2/exhibitors/{eventId}/list, outside the standard event resource path.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration; incremental fetching supports integration sync.
ai.oc: GET /api/v3/events/{eventId}/exhibitors with page, limit and timestamp filters, x-lang support and the standard response envelope.

ai.s: Adds a new V3 endpoint listing exhibitors deleted from an event, so integrations can detect and act on removals.
ai.pr: There was no API endpoint for integrations to find exhibitors removed from an event; V2 had no equivalent.
ai.wy: Needed for integration sync flows; mirrors the deleted-accounts endpoint in the V3 migration.
ai.oc: GET /api/v3/events/{eventId}/exhibitors/deleted returns a paginated list with deletion dates and an optional timestamp filter.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing event account by its internal ID, sending only the fields that change.
ai.pr: In V2, account updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/account/set, with no dedicated update call keyed on the internal ID.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create (EP-51306) and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/accounts/{accountId} specified with all-optional fields, including status, profile data and photo.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing event's details by its internal ID.
ai.pr: In V2, event updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/event/set.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create (EP-51328) and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId} specified with optional title, country, city, dates and venue fields and validations.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing exhibitor within an event by its internal ID.
ai.pr: In V2, exhibitor updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/exhibitor/set.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create (EP-51331) and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/exhibitors/{exhibitorId} specified with all-optional profile, contact and image fields.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing floor plan stand, including its hall and zone flags.
ai.pr: In V2, /api/v2/floorplan/setStand handled both creating and updating stands.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/floorplan/stands/{standId} specified with optional hallId, name and conference, check-in and buyer lounge flags.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing floor plan hall's name and image by its internal ID.
ai.pr: In V2, hall updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/floorplan/setHall.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create (EP-51340) and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/floorplan/halls/{hallId} specified with optional name and image upload or URL.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing event news item by its ID.
ai.pr: In V2, news updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/news/set.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create (EP-51346) and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/news/{newsId} specified with optional headline, body, teaser, author and image fields.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing session by its internal ID, sending only the fields that change.
ai.pr: In V2, session updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/sessions/set.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create (EP-51368) and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/sessions/{sessionId} specified with optional title, type, track and other fields, validated against EP data.

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint that replaces an account's whole My Schedule with a given list of sessions.
ai.pr: The API could add sessions to a schedule but had no way to overwrite it in full, so removed sessions stayed in place.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration; complements POST /calendar (EP-51310).
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/accounts/{accountId}/calendar replaces the schedule, removing sessions not in the new sessionIds list.

ai.s: Builds a secured backend API so the HR onboarding tool can create Admin Panel and Client Manager users automatically instead of by hand.
ai.pr: Admin Panel users were created manually, so onboarding new staff depended on manual set-up of accounts, access and permissions.
ai.wy: Internal efficiency: automate user onboarding from the HR onboarding tool (follows EP-51115).
ai.oc: An API, secured with a long-lived token, that creates admin users with name, job title, email, admin category, event access and page permissions.

ai.s: Makes GDPR handling and filtering consistent across the Meeting Program.

ai.wy: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; implied compliance need.

ai.s: Lets organisers configure the Sold Out page shown when all registration tickets are gone, with image, title, description and call-to-action.
ai.pr: Organisers had no configurable page to tell participants that tickets had sold out and point them somewhere useful.
ai.wy: Part of Participant Registration on the new UI.
ai.oc: A Sold Out settings tab under Registration setup, after the Confirmation page tab, with toggleable image, title, description and button and default texts.

ai.s: Shows participants a clear Sold Out page when no tickets are available to them, with a route back to the event page.
ai.pr: Participants trying to register for a sold-out event, or one with no tickets for their category or country, had no clear sold-out message.
ai.wy: Part of Participant Registration on the new UI.
ai.oc: The Sold Out page replaces registration when tickets are sold out globally or for the participant's category or country, before or after email validation, using organiser content.

ai.s: Adds payment to the new registration flow, so paid items are paid before registration completes, with Basket exceptions.
ai.pr: The new registration flow needed a defined way to take payment for paid items booked during registration.
ai.wy: Part of Participant Registration on the new UI.
ai.oc: Submit on the Summary page redirects to the Payment page, then to the Confirmation page; private events with public access and reached limits add items to the Basket.

summary: Participant can select and purchase tickets during registration

ai.s: Lets participants select and purchase tickets on a Tickets tab during registration, with category-based restrictions.
ai.pr: The new registration flow lacked a step for participants to choose tickets for specific event dates under their category.
ai.wy: Part of Participant Registration on the new UI.
ai.oc: A Tickets tab, shown when ticketing is on for participants, requires at least one ticket to continue, with add and remove feedback and category rules.

ai.s: Adds a Summary page at the end of registration where participants review their details and paid items, apply discounts and proceed.
ai.pr: Participants had no consolidated view of their registration data and selected paid items before submitting or paying.
ai.wy: Registration flow improvement on the new UI.
ai.oc: A configurable Summary tab showing each chosen tab as a block with Edit links, organiser title and description, and paid items with discounts.

ai.s: Lets participants complete registration after the limit is reached, joining a waiting list and activating once the organiser approves.
ai.pr: The new registration flow had no defined behaviour when the registration limit was reached.
ai.wy: Part of Participant Registration on the new UI.
ai.oc: Over-limit registrations go to Waiting list status with a waiting list email; approval sends an activation link, and reserved paid items can then be paid.
